title: MESS-datasets Per-Record Manifest
description: One manifest.json per ingested record under data/<source>/<id>/. Lists every file in the upstream record with checksum and whether it's committed in-tree or lives under the gitignored .source/ sidecar.

source.description: Upstream source. New sources (figshare, ncbi, ...) are added here as we ingest them.

id.description: Record ID within the source's namespace.

paper_doi.description: DOI of the published paper this record supplements, if known. Figshare exposes this as `resource_doi`; Zenodo may expose via `related_identifiers` (relation=isSupplementTo). Join key to a papers database.

fetched_at.description: UTC timestamp when the fetcher last ran.

committed.description: True if the file lives under files/ and is tracked in git. False if it's under .source/ (gitignored).

local_path.description: Path relative to the record directory where the file lives locally.

skipped_reason.description: If the fetcher couldn't download this file (network, gone, etc.), the reason.
